sloka: तद्युवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समास्थितौ ।गायेथां मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् ।। ७.९३.१६ ॥
transliteration: tadyuvāṁ hṛṣṭamanasau śvaḥ prabhāte samāsthitau ।gāyethāṁ madhuraṁ geyaṁ tantrīlayasamanvitam ।। 7.93.16 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, you two, with joyful minds, should take your seats tomorrow morning and sing the sweet song, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.
